entries.name: Barbell Incline Bench Press - Medium Grip
entries.reason: Own drawn frames authored for this repository: the family-4 supine press body reclined 25 degrees onto an incline bench (spine exactly 24, neck exactly 9), the bar pressed along a near-vertical line from the upper chest and drawn end-on with its plates (Entry 0181 side-view rule). Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Ten drawn positions of an incline barbell bench press.......

frames.caption: Start with the bar over your upper chest, wrists stacked over the elbows.
Lower the bar toward the upper chest.
Keep the bar path the same as it descends.
Elbows stay under the bar on the way down.
Bar at the upper chest; keep the chest open.
Pause at the chest with the shoulder blades set.
Drive through the bar and keep the path the same.
Press straight through the same line.
Keep pressing until the arms straighten.
Finish over the upper chest with straight arms.

entries.name: Hammer Grip Incline DB Bench Press
entries.reason: Own drawn frames: the incline body with a dumbbell in each hand drawn standing vertical (the neutral pair at a tightened far offset). Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Ten drawn positions of a hammer-grip incline dumbbell press.

frames.caption: Start with a dumbbell in each hand above the shoulders, palms facing each other.
Lower both dumbbells under control.
Keep the palms facing each other as they descend.
Keep the elbows tucked beside the ribs as the bells come down.
Bells at the sides of the chest; keep the chest open.
Pause at the bottom of the rep.
Press the dumbbells back up together.
Keep the palms facing each other on the way up.
Press until the arms are nearly straight.
Finish with the arms straight and the bells together.

entries.name: Incline Cable Chest Press
entries.reason: Redrawn on 9 October 2026 at the owner's request, from the description accepted that day: the earlier drawing was a side view that showed neither the two low pulleys nor the handles coming together. Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 28 degrees so both cables and the arms' path show: lying back on a bench raised 40 degrees between two low pulleys, head and hips on the pad and feet on the floor; the handles start out from the chest with the upper arms about forty-five degrees from the sides and the elbows at right angles, and are pressed up and together until the arms are straight, a pause, and a slower lowering. Each cable only lengthens on the press. Not drawn: taking the handles one at a time while sitting up.
entries.summary: Lying back on an incline bench between two low cables, press the handles up and together above the upper chest until the arms are straight, pause, then lower slowly with the cables tight.

frames.caption: Set an incline bench to about 30 to 45 degrees between two pulleys at their lowest setting, then lie back with your head, shoulders and hips on the pad and feet flat on the floor, upper arms about forty-five degrees from your sides and elbows bent to about ninety degrees.
Keeping the shoulder blades drawn back, press the handles up and together above the upper chest until the arms are straight.
Pause. Shoulder blades back, head on the pad.
Lower slowly to the start, keeping tension on the cables.
Press up and together.

entries.name: Incline Dumbbell Bench With Palms Facing In
entries.reason: Own drawn frames: the incline body and the same neutral bells, with the elbows ridden out at the shoulder line and folded to about ninety degrees at the bottom, exactly as its own stored instruction sets the upper arms; the lowering runs twice the press (its cue). Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Ten drawn positions of an incline dumbbell press with palms

frames.caption: Start with the dumbbells above the shoulders, palms facing each other.
Lower twice as slowly as you plan to press.
Keep the weights moving down to the sides.
Let the elbows ride out in line with the shoulders.
Weights down to the sides; elbows bent to about ninety degrees.
Pause at the bottom of the rep.
Press back up twice as fast as the lowering.
Keep the palms facing each other the whole way.
Press until the arms are nearly straight.
Finish with the arms straight above you.
